answer: The verification trail is short enough to audit by hand and long enough to catch a farm. The farm rehearsed the oasis, it rehearsed the mesa, but it never rehearsed the garden, because a year cannot be rehearsed. The stake vests back only after 14 days of clean grading, so a farm's 100775 POA is hostage to its own behaviour. Ask for Brewer hop sack seal brewed at the mash room and the farms go quiet, because each hop sack is a measured brew yield plus a guild signature is not something a printer can fake.
